Diarrhea
Deﬁ nition Diarrhea is deﬁ ned as an increase in frequency 
of bowel movements and/or an increase in water content of 
stools that aﬀ ects either the consistency or the volume of fecal
output. Other deﬁ nitions describe abnormality in stool produc-
tion as >200 g/day for adults and >20 g/kg for children.30
Epidemiology Incidence of infectious diarrhea is estimat-
ed to be approximately 99 million new cases each year, result-
ing in 3100 deaths each year in the United States. Food-borne
illnesses are a major cause of these cases. According to the
